title: From Monovalent EV-A71 Vaccines to Multivalent Vaccines Against Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease in China: Development Progress, Evidence Gaps, and Translational Challenges
abstract: Hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD) is caused by several enteroviruses, with enterovirus A71 (EV-A71) most strongly associated with severe disease and death. Licensed monovalent inactivated EV-A71 vaccines in China have a substantial evidence base for safety, immunogenicity, protective efficacy, and real-world effectiveness, together with relatively mature clinical evaluation and quality control systems. Their protection, however, is predominantly type-specific and does not extend reliably to major non-EV-A71 enteroviruses such as coxsackievirus A16 (CVA16), CVA6, or CVA10. As EV-A71-associated disease has declined, these viruses have become more prominent among residual cases and outbreaks, although shifts in etiological proportions should not be equated with vaccine-driven type replacement. This review synthesizes evidence on the developmental basis and limits of monovalent EV-A71 vaccination and evaluates multivalent candidates based on inactivated virus, virus-like particles (VLPs), chimeric antigens, and nucleic acid platforms. Most multivalent evidence remains preclinical, and major translational gaps include the absence of population-validated correlates of protection for non-EV-A71 types, uncertain antigenic coverage, component-specific quality control requirements, immune response imbalance, clinical case accrual, pediatric safety, coadministration, and affordability. We therefore propose a stage-gated framework that separates developmental maturity from public health priority and evaluates each additional antigen according to product objectives, sustained absolute disease burden, antigenic coverage, manufacturing readiness, immune response balance, clinical evaluability, and incremental public health value. Under this framework, higher valency is a conditional development choice rather than an objective in itself, and vaccine composition should be adapted to regional epidemiology and measurable added benefit over lower valency comparators.

analysis.summary_en: This review focuses on the development and evaluation of monovalent and multivalent vaccines against human enteroviruses, particularly EV-A71, which is strongly associated with severe Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease (HFMD). The evidence highlights the substantial safety, immunogenicity, and effectiveness of monovalent EV-A71 vaccines in China, but notes their limited protection against other enteroviruses like CVA16, CVA6, and CVA10. The review emphasizes the need for multivalent vaccine strategies to address the increasing role of non-EV-A71 viruses in HFMD outbreaks. The paper proposes a stage-gated framework for evaluating multivalent vaccine development, prioritizing public health value and regional epidemiology over valency alone.

abstract_zh: 手足口病(HFMD)由多种肠道病毒引起,其中肠道病毒A71(EV-A71)与严重疾病和死亡最为相关。在中国,已获批的单价灭活EV-A71 疫苗具有充分的安全性、免疫原性、保护效力和实际效果的证据基础,同时具备相对成熟的临床评估和质量控制体系。然而,其保护作用主要针对特定型别,无法可靠地扩展到主要的非EV-A71肠道病毒,如柯萨奇病毒A16(CVA16)、CVA6或CVA10。随着EV-A71相关病例的减少,这些病毒在剩余病例和暴发中变得更加突出,尽管病原体比例的变化不应等同于由疫苗驱动的型别替代。本综述总结了单价EV-A71 疫苗接种的研发基础和局限性,并基于灭活病毒、病毒样颗粒(VLPs)、嵌合抗原和核酸平台评估多价候选疫苗。目前大多数多价证据仍处于临床前阶段,主要的转化缺口包括缺乏对非EV-A71型别的群体验证的保护相关指标、抗原覆盖范围不确定、成分特异性质量控制要求、免疫应答失衡、临床病例积累、儿童安全性、联合接种以及可负担性。因此,我们提出一个分阶段框架,将研发成熟度与公共卫生优先级分开,并根据产品目标、持续的绝对疾病负担、抗原覆盖范围、制造准备度、免疫应答平衡、临床可评估性以及增量公共卫生价值来评估每种额外抗原。在该框架下,更高的价型是一种有条件的研发选择,而非其本身的目标,疫苗的组成应根据地区流行病学和相对于低价对照品的可衡量附加效益进行调整。

title: Development of Enterovirus D68 3C Protease Inhibitors with In Vivo Efficacy in a Neurological Infection Model
abstract: Abstract Enterovirus D68 (EV-D68) is a non-polio enterovirus that primarily causes respiratory illness but can also lead to severe disease, including acute flaccid myelitis. No approved vaccine or antiviral is available. Here, we report the rational design and structure−property optimization of dipeptidyl EV-D68 3C protease (3Cpro) inhibitors. Structure-guided optimization and prodrug modification identified Jun13133 as a potent antiviral active against multiple contemporary EV-D68 isolates and EV-A71, with high selectivity. Computational modeling supported a stable substrate-mimetic binding mode consistent with reported covalent 3Cpro inhibitors. Jun13133 also showed favorable in vivo pharmacokinetic properties. In a neonatal mouse model of EV-D68-induced neurological disease, Jun13133 mitigated paralysis, prevented weight loss, and reduced viral replication in spinal cord and muscle tissues. These results validate EV-D68 3Cpro as a druggable antiviral target and support Jun13133 as a promising lead for further development.

title_zh: 开发针对Enterovirus D68神经感染模型具有体内疗效的3C蛋白酶抑制剂
source_body_en: Abstract Enterovirus D68 (EV-D68) is a non-polio enterovirus that primarily causes respiratory illness but can also lead to severe disease, including acute flaccid myelitis. No approved vaccine or antiviral is available. Here, we report the rational design and structure−property optimization of dipeptidyl EV-D68 3C protease (3Cpro) inhibitors. Structure-guided optimization and prodrug modification identified Jun13133 as a potent antiviral active against multiple contemporary EV-D68 isolates and EV-A71, with high selectivity. Computational modeling supported a stable substrate-mimetic binding mode consistent with reported covalent 3Cpro inhibitors. Jun13133 also showed favorable in vivo pharmacokinetic properties. In a neonatal mouse model of EV-D68-induced neurological disease, Jun13133 mitigated paralysis, prevented weight loss, and reduced viral replication in spinal cord and muscle tissues. These results validate EV-D68 3Cpro as a druggable antiviral target and support Jun13133 as a promising lead for further development.
abstract_zh: 摘要 Enterovirus D68(EV-D68)是一种非脊髓灰质炎肠道病毒,主要引起呼吸道疾病,但也可能导致严重疾病,包括急性弛缓性脊髓炎。目前尚无获批的抗病毒药物或治疗方案用于该非脊髓灰质炎肠道病毒。本文报告了针对EV-D68 3C蛋白酶(3Cpro)的二肽类抑制剂的合理设计和结构-性质优化。结构指导的优化和前药修饰确定了Jun13133,这是一种对多种当前EV-D68分离株和EV-A71具有高选择性的强效抗病毒药物。计算建模支持了该抑制剂稳定的底物模拟结合模式,与已报道的共价3Cpro抑制剂一致。Jun13133还表现出良好的体内药代动力学特性。在EV-D68诱导的神经疾病新生小鼠模型中,Jun13133减轻了瘫痪,防止了体重减轻,并减少了脊髓和肌肉组织中的病毒复制。这些结果验证了EV-D68 3Cpro作为可药用治疗靶点的潜力,并支持Jun13133作为进一步开发的有前景的先导化合物。

title: Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease Surveillance in Anhui, After Introduction of the Enterovirus 71 Vaccine and During the COVID-19 Pandemic: Ecological Interrupted Time Series Study.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Routine surveillance is important for understanding hand, foot, and mouth disease (HFMD) after monovalent enterovirus 71 (EV71) vaccine introduction, but interpretation is difficult when etiologic typing is sparse and the COVID-19 pandemic overlaps with the postvaccine era. OBJECTIVE: This study described surveillance-derived changes in HFMD burden and typed serotype composition in Anhui Province, China, after EV71 vaccine introduction and during the COVID-19 pandemic. METHODS: We conducted a retrospective ecological surveillance study using HFMD records from January 2008 to December 2023. The primary analysis used negative-binomial interrupted time series (ITS) counterfactual models for all reported HFMD cases and typed EV71 monthly counts. Vaccine-era models were trained using data from January 2013 through May 2016; the previous specification covering January 2010 through May 2016 was retained as a sensitivity analysis. COVID-19-period models were trained using data from January 2008 through December 2019. Secondary analyses assessed spatial, temporal, and age patterns. Vaccine coverage histories, individual vaccination records, specimen submission metadata, and laboratory platform-change metadata were unavailable; therefore, models estimated calendar-based surveillance deviations rather than vaccine effectiveness. RESULTS: Anhui reported 1,292,579 HFMD cases from 2008 to 2023, including 47,990 (3.7%) typed cases. EV71 declined from 45.8% (8479/18,534) of typed cases before vaccine introduction to 3.4% (578/16,930) during COVID-19, while other enteroviruses increased from 29.6% (5487/18,534) to 81.8% (13,848/16,930). There were 123 deaths from 2008 to 2023, corresponding to 9.52 deaths per 100,000 reported cases; no deaths were recorded from 2020 to 2023. In primary vaccine-era ITS models, typed EV71 counts remained below the predicted trajectory in 2017 to 2019: 470 observed vs 659 predicted cases (95% prediction interval [PI] 467-933) in 2017, 181 vs 531 (95% PI 379-798) in 2018, and 63 vs 427 (95% PI 305-662) in 2019. All reported HFMD cases were not uniformly below the vaccine-era counterfactual. During the COVID-19 pandemic, all reported HFMD cases remained below prediction through 2023, with the largest relative difference in 2022 (28,385 observed vs 175,601 predicted; 95% PI 111,465-268,202). The proportion of reported children aged ≥4 years increased from 19% (50,503/266,132) during 2017 to 2019 to 29.1% (44,133/151,795) during 2021 to 2023 (odds ratio 1.75, 95% CI 1.72-1.78; P<.001). CONCLUSIONS: Typed EV71 surveillance signals declined after EV71 vaccine introduction, and overall HFMD burden was strongly disrupted during the COVID-19 pandemic. However, sparse typing, unavailable vaccination and testing policy metadata, and the aggregated other enteroviruses category limit causal interpretation. These findings should be read as surveillance signals, not as direct estimates of population-level serotype replacement or individual-level vaccine protection.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to understand changes in hand, foot, and mouth disease (HFMD) burden and serotype composition in Anhui Province, China, after the introduction of the monovalent enterovirus 71 (EV71) vaccine and during the COVID-19 pandemic, as routine surveillance is important for tracking HFMD but interpretation is challenging due to sparse etiologic typing and overlapping events.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A retrospective ecological surveillance study was conducted using HFMD records from January 2008 to December 2023 in Anhui Province, China. The study focused on the period after EV71 vaccine introduction and during the COVID-19 pandemic, analyzing changes in HFMD burden and serotype composition across different years.
analysis.methods: The primary analysis used negative-binomial interrupted time series (ITS) counterfactual models for all reported HFMD cases and typed EV71 monthly counts. Vaccine-era models were trained using data from January 2013 through May 2016, with a previous specification covering January 2010 through May 2016 retained for sensitivity analysis. Secondary analyses assessed spatial, temporal, and age patterns of HFMD cases.
analysis.main_results: Anhui reported 1,292,579 HFMD cases from 2008 to 2023, including 47,990 (3.7%) typed cases. EV71 declined from 45.8% (8479/18,534) of typed cases before vaccine introduction to 3.4% (578/16,930) during the COVID-19 pandemic, while other enteroviruses increased from 29.6% (5487/18,534) to 81.8% (13,848/16,930). There were 123 deaths from 2008 to 2023, corresponding to 9.52 deaths per 100,000 reported cases; no deaths were recorded from 2020 to 2023. In primary vaccine-era ITS models, typed EV71 counts remained below the predicted trajectory in 2017 to 2019, with observed cases significantly lower than predicted. All reported HFMD cases were not uniformly below the vaccine-era counterfactual.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as indicating a decline in typed EV71 surveillance signals following the introduction of the EV71 vaccine and a strong disruption in overall HFMD burden during the COVID-19 pandemic. This study provides novel insights into the impact of vaccine introduction and pandemic conditions on HFMD surveillance data.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform surveillance strategies for HFMD and highlight the importance of considering pandemic effects on disease reporting. They also suggest the need for continued monitoring of serotype composition and HFMD burden to guide public health interventions.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: Sparse typing, lack of vaccination and testing policy metadata, and the aggregated other enteroviruses category limit causal interpretation. The evidence is moderate, as the study relies on ecological data and models that estimate surveillance deviations rather than direct vaccine effectiveness.

analysis.summary_en: This study analyzed changes in hand, foot, and mouth disease (HFMD) burden and serotype composition in Anhui Province, China, after the introduction of the monovalent enterovirus 71 (EV71) vaccine and during the COVID-19 pandemic. Using ecological surveillance data from 2008 to 2023, the researchers applied interrupted time series (ITS) models to assess the impact of the vaccine and pandemic on HFMD cases. They found a significant decline in EV71 cases and an increase in other enteroviruses, with overall HFMD burden strongly disrupted during the pandemic. The study highlights the importance of surveillance in understanding disease dynamics but notes limitations in causal interpretation due to sparse typing and lack of detailed vaccination data. These findings can inform public health strategies for HFMD monitoring and response during future outbreaks.

title_zh: Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease Surveillance in Anhui, After Introduction of the Enterovirus 71 Vaccine and During the COVID-19 Pandemic: Ecological Interrupted Time Series Study.
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Routine surveillance is important for understanding hand, foot, and mouth disease (HFMD) after monovalent enterovirus 71 (EV71) vaccine introduction, but interpretation is difficult when etiologic typing is sparse and the COVID-19 pandemic overlaps with the postvaccine era. OBJECTIVE: This study described surveillance-derived changes in HFMD burden and typed serotype composition in Anhui Province, China, after EV71 vaccine introduction and during the COVID-19 pandemic. METHODS: We conducted a retrospective ecological surveillance study using HFMD records from January 2008 to December 2023. The primary analysis used negative-binomial interrupted time series (ITS) counterfactual models for all reported HFMD cases and typed EV71 monthly counts. Vaccine-era models were trained using data from January 2013 through May 2016; the previous specification covering January 2010 through May 2016 was retained as a sensitivity analysis. COVID-19-period models were trained using data from January 2008 through December 2019. Secondary analyses assessed spatial, temporal, and age patterns. Vaccine coverage histories, individual vaccination records, specimen submission metadata, and laboratory platform-change metadata were unavailable; therefore, models estimated calendar-based surveillance deviations rather than vaccine effectiveness. RESULTS: Anhui reported 1,292,579 HFMD cases from 2008 to 2023, including 47,990 (3.7%) typed cases. EV71 declined from 45.8% (8479/18,534) of typed cases before vaccine introduction to 3.4% (578/16,930) during COVID-19, while other enteroviruses increased from 29.6% (5487/18,534) to 81.8% (13,848/16,930). There were 123 deaths from 2008 to 2023, corresponding to 9.52 deaths per 100,000 reported cases; no deaths were recorded from 2020 to 2023. In primary vaccine-era ITS models, typed EV71 counts remained below the predicted trajectory in 2017 to 2019: 470 observed vs 659 predicted cases (95% prediction interval [PI] 467-933) in 2017, 181 vs 531 (95% PI 379-798) in 2018, and 63 vs 427 (95% PI 305-662) in 2019. All reported HFMD cases were not uniformly below the vaccine-era counterfactual. During the COVID-19 pandemic, all reported HFMD cases remained below prediction through 2023, with the largest relative difference in 2022 (28,385 observed vs 175,601 predicted; 95% PI 111,465-268,202). The proportion of reported children aged ≥4 years increased from 19% (50,503/266,132) during 2017 to 2019 to 29.1% (44,133/151,795) during 2021 to 2023 (odds ratio 1.75, 95% CI 1.72-1.78; P<.001). CONCLUSIONS: Typed EV71 surveillance signals declined after EV71 vaccine introduction, and overall HFMD burden was strongly disrupted during the COVID-19 pandemic. However, sparse typing, unavailable vaccination and testing policy metadata, and the aggregated other enteroviruses category limit causal interpretation. These findings should be read as surveillance signals, not as direct estimates of population-level serotype replacement or individual-level vaccine protection.

title: Virucidal Efficacy of Holder Pasteurization of Breast Milk in a Portable Device
abstract: Breast milk is the optimal nutrition for infants. However, a number of viruses can accumulate in breast milk and be transmitted to a newborn during breastfeeding. Holder pasteurization is a gold-standard method for breast milk treatment, achieving an acceptable compromise between microbiological safety and biological quality. We have evaluated the virucidal activity of Holder pasteurization of breast milk contaminated with RNA and DNA viruses in a portable home-use pasteurizer. Viruses were selected on basis of their ability to infect humans, contaminate breast milk, and pose a threat for a newborn. The efficacy was evaluated in experimental conditions using breast milk samples from four different donors. Infectious virus and viral genome content were assessed. Holder pasteurization resulted in a decrease in infectivity below the detection limit for enveloped RNA viruses (HIV-1, CHIKV, and SARS-CoV-2), but not RSV, and a partial decrease in infectious virus titer for non-enveloped RNA enteroviruses (EV-A71, E30, and PV1), and DNA viruses (hAdV5 and HSV-1). Moreover, infectivity reduction in E30 and PV1 in different samples of breast milk significantly differed. Therefore, Holder pasteurization can be a tool in the novel pandemic preparedness toolbox or probably help mothers manage breastfeeding during common infections.

title: High-throughput sequencing reveals the virome characteristics of wastewater in Gansu Province, China from 2024 to 2026
abstract: Emerging and re-emerging infectious diseases continue to pose a persistent challenge to global public health security. As an unbiased and noninvasive population-level surveillance approach, wastewater-based epidemiology has emerged as an urban-scale monitoring tool for proactively capturing the community disease burden. In this study, metagenomic and targeted next-generation sequencing were employed to preliminarily characterize wastewater viral communities in Gansu Province from 2024 to 2026. Across the three annual sampling groups, the Simpson diversity index calculated from metagenomic taxonomic profiles showed a significant negative correlation with sampling year. Despite viral enrichment, more than 97% of sequencing reads were assigned to bacteria, likely reflecting residual nonviral nucleic acids and limitations in metagenomic classification. The wastewater virome exhibited a complex host-association spectrum, within which bacteriophages and plant-associated viruses displayed relatively stable community structures and high relative abundances. Among human pathogens, astroviruses were consistently detected at high relative abundances across all samples. Human astrovirus 1 accounted for the largest proportion, and a nearly complete genome sequence of the extraintestinal infection-associated astrovirus MLB2 was recovered. Targeted sequencing further revealed a highly structured environmental enterovirus profile dominated by the species Enterovirus betacoxsackie , followed by Enterovirus alphacoxsackie , whereas Enterovirus coxsackiepol was detected at an extremely low abundance and Enterovirus deconjuncti was not detected. In addition to several common viruses associated with hand, foot, and mouth disease, rare viruses, including coxsackievirus A19 and enterovirus B83, were successfully captured. Echovirus 11 was identified as the predominant enterovirus serotype in current wastewater surveillance in Gansu Province. In summary, this study provides a preliminary characterization of the viral community profiles in wastewater samples from Gansu Province, demonstrates the effectiveness of wastewater-based epidemiology for population-level surveillance, and underscores the need to establish a coordinated defense network integrating clinical case surveillance with environmental monitoring.

abstract_zh: 新兴和再新兴传染病持续对全球公共卫生安全构成严峻挑战。作为一种无偏见且非侵入性的群体水平监测方法,基于污水的病毒组监测已成为城市规模主动捕捉社区疾病负担的工具。本研究采用宏基因组和靶向下一代测序技术,初步表征了2024至2026年中国甘肃省污水中的病毒群落。在三个年度采样组中,宏基因组分类谱计算出的辛普森多样性指数与采样年份呈显著负相关。尽管进行了病毒富集,超过97%的测序读段被归类为细菌,这可能反映了残留的非病毒核酸以及宏基因组分类的局限性。污水病毒组表现出复杂的病毒-宿主关联谱,其中噬菌体和植物相关病毒显示出相对稳定的群落结构和较高的相对丰度。在人类病原体中,星状病毒在所有样本中均被持续检测到,相对丰度较高。人类星状病毒1占最大比例,且获得了与肠外感染相关的星状病毒MLB2几乎完整的基因组序列。靶向测序进一步揭示了以肠病毒β-柯萨奇病毒为主导的结构化环境肠病毒谱,其次是肠病毒α-柯萨奇病毒,而肠病毒柯萨奇病毒B型则检测到极低丰度,肠病毒脱垂病毒则未被检测到。除了几种与手足口病相关的常见病毒外,还成功捕获了罕见病毒,包括柯萨奇病毒A19和肠病毒B83。研究确定肠病毒11是当前甘肃省污水中主要的肠病毒血清型,突显了其在社区传播中的潜在作用。总之,本研究初步表征了甘肃省污水样本中的病毒群落特征,展示了基于污水的病毒组监测在群体水平监测中的有效性,并强调了建立整合临床病例监测与环境监测的协调防御网络的必要性。

title: CaMKIIγ-mediated vimentin structural rearrangement regulates FMDV replication.
abstract: FMDV infection induces rearrangement of host cell membrane structures and recruits various proteins to form a replication complex for viral replication. Vimentin, a major component of type III intermediate filaments, has been implicated in the replication processes of multiple viruses. This study identifies that Vimentin interacts with FMDV 2 C and participates in replication complex formation. Knockout of Vimentin significantly suppressed FMDV replication in BHK-21 cells. FMDV infection did not affect Vimentin expression but instead induced the rearrangement of Vimentin network structure. Treatment with IDPN and acrylamide disrupted Vimentin structural rearrangement and inhibited FMDV replication. Furthermore, we demonstrated that FMDV upregulates CaMKIIγ expression, which in turn promotes Vimentin phosphorylation at Ser39 and Ser83 to induce structural rearrangement. Inhibiting CaMKIIγ activity resulted in a significant reduction in FMDV replication. Overexpression of Vimentin effectively enhanced the replication of several RNA viruses, including Poliovirus type 1, Enterovirus 71, Respiratory enteric orphan virus type 3 strain 176, Coxsackievirus A16, and Human parainfluenza virus type 2. Our results indicate that Vimentin regulates the replication of multiple RNA viruses, providing a theoretical reference for in-depth investigation into the mechanisms of RNA virus infection and the development of antiviral drugs.

abstract_original: FMDV infection induces rearrangement of host cell membrane structures and recruits various proteins to form a replication complex for viral replication. Vimentin, a major component of type III intermediate filaments, has been implicated in the replication processes of multiple viruses. This study identifies that Vimentin interacts with FMDV 2 C and participates in replication complex formation. Knockout of Vimentin significantly suppressed FMDV replication in BHK-21 cells. FMDV infection did not affect Vimentin expression but instead induced the rearrangement of Vimentin network structure. Treatment with IDPN and acrylamide disrupted Vimentin structural rearrangement and inhibited FMDV replication. Furthermore, we demonstrated that FMDV upregulates CaMKIIγ expression, which in turn promotes Vimentin phosphorylation at Ser39 and Ser83 to induce structural rearrangement. Inhibiting CaMKIIγ activity resulted in a significant reduction in FMDV replication. Overexpression of Vimentin effectively enhanced the replication of several RNA viruses, including Poliovirus type 1, Enterovirus 71, Respiratory enteric orphan virus type 3 strain 176, Coxsackievirus A16, and Human parainfluenza virus type 2. Our results indicate that Vimentin regulates the replication of multiple RNA viruses, providing a theoretical reference for in-depth investigation into the mechanisms of RNA virus infection and the development of antiviral drugs.
title_original: CaMKIIγ-mediated vimentin structural rearrangement regulates FMDV replication.

analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted in BHK-21 cells, focusing on the interaction between FMDV and vimentin. It involved knockout experiments and treatment with specific compounds to assess their effects on viral replication.
analysis.methods: The methods included knockout of vimentin, treatment with IDPN and acrylamide, and overexpression of vimentin to evaluate its impact on FMDV replication. The study also demonstrated FMDV's ability to upregulate CaMKIIγ expression, which promotes vimentin phosphorylation.
analysis.main_results: Knockout of vimentin significantly suppressed FMDV replication in BHK-21 cells. Treatment with IDPN and acrylamide disrupted vimentin structural rearrangement and inhibited FMDV replication. FMDV upregulates CaMKIIγ expression, leading to vimentin phosphorylation at Ser39 and Ser83.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that vimentin structural rearrangement is a critical factor in FMDV replication, mediated by CaMKIIγ. This provides novel insights into the molecular mechanisms of RNA virus infection.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results offer a theoretical basis for understanding RNA virus replication mechanisms and could inform the development of antiviral strategies targeting vimentin and CaMKIIγ.

The research identifies CaMKIIγ as a mediator of vimentin phosphorylation, which facilitates the formation of a replication complex. The findings provide novel insights into RNA virus infection mechanisms and suggest avenues for antiviral drug development. However, the study is limited to in vitro experiments, which may affect the generalizability of the results. The evidence is moderate, as it is based on cell culture data without clinical application.

abstract_zh: FMDV感染诱导了宿主细胞膜结构的重排,并招募多种蛋白质形成复制复合体以进行病毒复制。波形蛋白是III型中间丝的主要成分,已被证实参与多种病毒的复制过程。本研究发现波形蛋白与FMDV 2C蛋白相互作用,并参与复制复合体的形成。波形蛋白的敲除显著抑制了BHK-21细胞中FMDV的复制。FMDV感染不影响波形蛋白的表达,但会诱导波形蛋白网络结构的重排。使用IDPN和丙烯酰胺处理的治疗破坏了波形蛋白的结构重排并抑制了FMDV复制。此外,我们证明FMDV上调CaMKIIγ的表达,进而促进波形蛋白在Ser39和Ser83位点的磷酸化,诱导结构重排。抑制CaMKIIγ活性显著降低了FMDV的复制。波形蛋白的过表达有效增强了多种RNA病毒的复制,包括脊髓灰质炎病毒1型、人肠道病毒71型、呼吸道肠道孤儿病毒3型176株、Coxsackievirus A16型和人副流感病毒2型。我们的结果表明波形蛋白调控多种RNA病毒的复制,为深入研究RNA病毒感染机制及开发抗病毒药物抗病毒药物提供了理论依据。

title: A Bayesian modelling framework for inference of latent infection risk patterns from virus neutralisation assay titration data
abstract: Serological assays remain the standard approach for estimating the cumulative incidence of a pathogen and monitoring population immunity. Titration data from virus neutralisation assays are conventionally analysed using a nearly century-old interpolation-based method that neglects inherent imperfections in the assay and produces estimates with no measure of uncertainty. We introduce a two-part Bayesian framework for inferring latent infection risk directly from raw titration data. First, we develop a mechanistic model for serum antibody titration data that estimates antibody concentrations while quantifying uncertainty. Second, we propagate this uncertainty into an age-structured sero-catalytic mixture model by integrating over posterior draws of individual antibody concentrations, allowing joint inference on latent serostate membership, force of infection, and serological waning rate. We applied the framework to three cross-sectional serosurveys of the population of England, for enteroviruses A71 (EV-A71) and D68 (EV-D68) and coxsackievirus A6 (CVA6), which are leading causes of severe respiratory illness and hand, foot, and mouth disease. We estimated consistently higher and more persistent lifetime antibody concentrations for EV-D68 than for EV-A71 and CVA6. The proportion of recently infected individuals peaks around 40% by age 5 years for CVA6 and around 32% by age 7 years for EV-A71, before declining with age. These estimates are conditional on a model structure excluding complete seroreversion, which, where identifiable, implied a half-life of several decades. For EV-D68, the inferred proportion previously infected exceeded 50% by age 13 years and grew, with the force of infection declining more gradually with age. These estimates differ from those previously obtained from binarised versions of the same data. Our framework uncovers the wide-ranging variation in antibody levels that are often obscured by conventional endpoint titre methods and infers infection rates directly from raw titration data, without dichotomising at predetermined seropositivity cut-offs, while making minimal assumptions about virus-specific infection mechanisms. Author summary Serological tests measure antibody levels to estimate virus spread and protection from infection (immunity). Virus neutralisation assays dilute serum samples in steps and mix them with virus and cell cultures. The antibody titre is the highest dilution at which cells are protected from infection. Traditional analyses discard much of the testing information and overlook test imperfections. We present a two-part Bayesian framework that estimates antibody concentrations from the raw dilution data, carries the resulting uncertainty forward, and infers age-specific transmission of three common viruses – EV-A71, EV-D68, and CVA6. Our results show that EV-D68 infections may be more common, especially in children, than the other two viruses. This approach gives a clearer picture of seroconversion dynamics without dichotomising samples at fixed thresholds and has potential to improve estimation of virus transmission and population susceptibility.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the limitations of conventional serological methods in estimating infection risk patterns by introducing a Bayesian framework that accounts for uncertainty in virus neutralisation assay titration data.

analysis.methods: The study introduced a two-part Bayesian framework: first, a mechanistic model to estimate antibody concentrations from raw titration data while quantifying uncertainty, and second, an age-structured sero-catalytic mixture model that integrates over posterior draws of individual antibody concentrations to infer latent serostate membership, force of infection, and serological waning rate.
analysis.main_results: The framework estimated consistently higher and more persistent lifetime antibody concentrations for EV-D68 compared to EV-A71 and CVA6. analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The results show that EV-D68 infections may be more common, especially in children, than the other two viruses. The framework provides a more accurate estimation of seroconversion dynamics by avoiding dichotomisation at fixed seropositivity thresholds.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform improved estimation of virus transmission and population susceptibility, offering a more nuanced understanding of infection patterns and immunity dynamics for EV-A71, EV-D68, and CVA6.

analysis.summary_en: This study introduces a Bayesian framework to estimate latent infection risk patterns from virus neutralisation assay titration data, addressing the limitations of traditional interpolation-based methods that neglect uncertainty. The framework was applied to three cross-sectional serosurveys in England focusing on EV-A71, EV-D68, and CVA6, which are leading causes of severe respiratory illness and hand, foot, and mouth disease. The results show that EV-D68 infections may be more common in children than the other two viruses, with higher and more persistent antibody concentrations. The study highlights the importance of considering antibody dynamics and uncertainty in serological analysis, offering a more accurate estimation of seroconversion dynamics without dichotomising samples at fixed thresholds. However, the estimates are conditional on excluding seroreversion, which may limit generalisability. The evidence strength is moderate, as the framework relies on assumptions about antibody dynamics and requires further validation.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在通过引入一种考虑病毒中和试验滴度数据中不确定性的贝叶斯框架,解决传统血清学方法在估计感染风险模式方面的局限性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该框架应用于英格兰人口的三项横断面血清流行调查,重点关注A71型肠道病毒(EV-A71)、D68型肠道病毒(EV-D68)和A6型柯萨奇病毒(CVA6)。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究引入了一种两部分的贝叶斯框架:首先,一个机制模型用于从原始滴度数据中估计抗体浓度并量化不确定性;其次,一个年龄结构化的血清催化混合模型,通过整合个体抗体浓度的后验抽样,推断潜在的血清状态归属、感染力和血清学衰减率。
elements_zh.main_results: 该框架估计EV-D68的终身抗体浓度比EV-A71和CVA6更高且更持久。近期感染个体的比例在CVA6中,5岁时达到约40%;在EV-A71中,7岁时达到约32%,随后随年龄增长而下降。对于EV-D68,估计的先前感染比例在13岁时超过50%,并且感染力随年龄增长而逐渐下降。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,EV-D68的感染可能比另外两种病毒更为常见,尤其是在儿童中。该框架通过避免在固定血清阳性阈值处对样本进行二元化处理,提供了对血清转换动态更准确的估计。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以用于改进病毒感染率和人群易感性的估计,为EV-A71、EV-D68和CVA6的感染模式及免疫动态提供更细致的理解。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 这些估计基于一个排除完全血清逆转的模型结构,这可能限制其推广性。证据强度中等,因为该框架依赖于关于抗体动态的假设,并需要进一步验证。

abstract_zh: 血清学检测仍然是估计病原体累积感染率和监测人群免疫力的标准方法。病毒中和试验的滴度数据通常使用一种近一个世纪的插值方法进行分析,这种方法忽略了试验本身固有的不完美性,并且产生的估计值没有不确定性度量。我们引入了一种两部分的贝叶斯框架,直接从原始滴度数据中推断潜在的感染风险模式。首先,我们开发了一个机制模型,用于估计血清抗体滴度数据中的抗体浓度,并量化不确定性。其次,我们将这种不确定性传播到一个年龄结构化的血清催化混合模型中,通过整合个体抗体浓度的后验抽样,实现对潜在血清状态归属、感染力和血清学衰减率的联合推断。我们将该框架应用于英格兰人口的三项横断面血清流行调查,调查对象包括引起严重呼吸道疾病和手足口病的主要病原体——A71型肠道病毒(EV-A71)、D68型肠道病毒(EV-D68)和A6型柯萨奇病毒(CVA6)。我们估计EV-D68的终身抗体浓度比EV-A71和CVA6更高且更持久。对于CVA6,近期感染个体的比例在5岁时达到约40%,对于EV-A71则在7岁时达到约32%,随后随年龄增长而下降。这些估计基于一个排除完全血清逆转的模型结构,该结构在可识别的情况下暗示了抗体的半衰期为数十年。对于EV-D68,估计的先前感染比例在13岁时超过50%,并且感染力随年龄增长而逐渐下降。这些估计与之前从相同数据二元化版本中获得的结果不同。我们的框架揭示了抗体水平的广泛变化,这些变化通常被传统终点滴度方法所掩盖,并且直接从原始滴度数据中推断感染率,而无需在预设的血清阳性阈值处进行二元化处理,同时对病毒特异性感染机制做出最少假设。作者摘要 血清学检测通过测量抗体水平来估计病毒传播情况和感染保护(免疫力)。病毒中和试验通过逐步稀释血清样本,并将其与病毒和细胞培养物混合来检测抗体水平。抗体滴度是细胞在何种最高稀释度下仍能被保护免受感染的度量。传统分析方法忽略了试验中的许多信息,并未考虑试验本身的不完美性。我们提出了一种两部分的贝叶斯框架,该框架从原始稀释数据中估计抗体浓度,将由此产生的不确定性向前传递,并直接从原始滴度数据中推断三种常见病毒——EV-A71、EV-D68和CVA6的年龄特异性感染率。我们的研究结果表明,EV-D68的感染可能比另外两种病毒更为常见,尤其是在儿童中。这种方法避免了在固定阈值处对样本进行二元化处理,从而更清晰地描绘了血清转换的动态过程,具有改进病毒感染率和人群易感性估计的潜力。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在通过引入一种考虑病毒中和试验滴度数据中不确定性的贝叶斯框架,解决传统血清学方法在估计感染风险模式方面的局限性。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该框架应用于英格兰人口的三项横断面血清流行调查,重点关注A71型肠道病毒(EV-A71)、D68型肠道病毒(EV-D68)和A6型柯萨奇病毒(CVA6)。
analysis_zh.methods: 本研究引入了一种两部分的贝叶斯框架:首先,一个机制模型用于从原始滴度数据中估计抗体浓度并量化不确定性;其次,一个年龄结构化的血清催化混合模型,通过整合个体抗体浓度的后验抽样,推断潜在的血清状态归属、感染力和血清学衰减率。
analysis_zh.main_results: 该框架估计EV-D68的终身抗体浓度比EV-A71和CVA6更高且更持久。近期感染个体的比例在CVA6中,5岁时达到约40%;在EV-A71中,7岁时达到约32%,随后随年龄增长而下降。对于EV-D68,估计的先前感染比例在13岁时超过50%,并且感染力随年龄增长而逐渐下降。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,EV-D68的感染可能比另外两种病毒更为常见,尤其是在儿童中。该框架通过避免在固定血清阳性阈值处对样本进行二元化处理,提供了对血清转换动态更准确的估计。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以用于改进病毒感染率和人群易感性的估计,为EV-A71、EV-D68和CVA6的感染模式及免疫动态提供更细致的理解。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 这些估计基于一个排除完全血清逆转的模型结构,这可能限制其推广性。证据强度中等,因为该框架依赖于关于抗体动态的假设,并需要进一步验证。

title: Optimization of a Human Anti-polio Monoclonal Antibody as a Potential Therapeutic Modality
abstract: Background Vaccines have been an essential tool in bringing the world close to polio eradication, with over 99.9% of the global population free of poliovirus. No antiviral drugs or monoclonal antibody products, however, are currently licensed for treatment of polio. We previously isolated a human monoclonal antibody (9H2) with potent neutralizing activity against all three poliovirus serotypes. To advance 9H2 as a therapeutic candidate, we optimized its sequence to extend serum half-life and improve manufacturability. Methods A Multi-Attribute Method under stress conditions identified post-translational modification sites, and AbacusTM ranked sequence liabilities. Six amino acid substitutions were introduced into the variable regions, generating 23 combinatorial variants. Codon-optimized genes were synthesized and engineered into a human immunoglobulin G1 backbone containing crystallizable fragment (Fc) mutations (M428L/N434S) to extend serum half-life. Constructs were transfected into CHO-K1 cells to generate stable pools in 24-well plates. Protein A–purified antibodies were characterized using biophysical assays and an in vitro poliovirus neutralization assay. Results All variants retained high in vitro neutralizing activity against poliovirus. A lead candidate was selected based on integrated assessment of biophysical properties across eight assays and expression yield. Conclusions Structure-guided engineering and experimental evaluation enabled optimization of the 9H2 antibody sequence and identification of a lead candidate suitable for clinical manufacturing as a potential anti-poliovirus immunotherapeutic agent.

title: Identification of Novel Acylthiourea-Based PROTACs Exhibiting Broad-Spectrum Antiviral Activity against Enteroviruses
abstract: Abstract Enteroviruses are the primary cause of hand, foot, and mouth disease (HFMD). The absence of broad-spectrum antivirals, due to high serotypic and genetic diversity, greatly hampers effective treatment. In this study, we developed a novel type of acylthiourea-based proteolysis-targeting chimeras (PROTACs) to induce targeted protein degradation. Compound X14 was identified as a potent candidate. X14 showed strong anti-EV71 activity by inhibiting viral replication. It directly binds to the EV71 3D polymerase with higher affinity than ribavirin and causes proteasome-dependent degradation of the 3D protein. X14 demonstrated broad-spectrum activity against representative EV-A, EV-B, EV-C, and EV-D enteroviruses and exhibited superior in vivo efficacy compared to the parent compound. X14 is a PROTAC targeting EV71 3D polymerase, making it a promising antiviral candidate and chemical tool for HFMD.

title: Mathematical Modeling of Polio Transmission Dynamics with the Impact of Immigration and Delay in Vaccination
abstract: Poliomyelitis (polio) remains a significant global health concern despite substantial progress in its eradication through vaccination. This study focused on the resurgence of polio in regions experiencing high immigration rates and delays in vaccination coverage. Polio, caused by the poliovirus, primarily spreads through the fecal-oral route and can result in permanent paralysis or death. Although both inactivated (IPV) and oral (OPV) polio vaccines have proven effective, challenges such as vaccine-derived virus transmission and insufficient intestinal immunity from IPV persist. This study aims to formulate a comprehensive mathematical model that incorporates immigration as a source of new susceptible individuals and integrates delay differential equations to represent postponed vaccination. Through this model, we quantify the combined effects of immigration and delayed vaccination on polio outbreak dynamics, including the timing and magnitude of transmission. Furthermore, the model evaluates the stability of the disease-free equilibrium and suggests strategies for mitigating outbreak risks through timely vaccination and improved public health responses. By addressing the limitations of existing models, this research provides critical guidance for policymakers and health professionals working toward the global eradication of polio especially in regions facing public health infrastructure challenges and high population mobility. The simulated result further reveal that increased vaccination delays or longer relaxation times can induce oscillatory behavior in infection dynamics, suggesting the urgent need for prompt immunization efforts.
journal: INTERNATIONAL JOURNAL OF APPLIED SCIENCE AND MATHEMATICAL THEORY

title: Poliovirus Infection in Children: A Comprehensive Review of Virology, Pathogenesis, Epidemiology and Global Eradication Efforts
abstract: Background: Poliomyelitis, caused by poliovirus, remains a significant public health concern despite global eradication efforts. This review comprehensively examines the virology, pathogenesis, epidemiology, clinical manifestations, and eradication strategies for poliovirus infection in children.  Methods: We conducted a narrative review of peer-reviewed literature, WHO reports, and Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) publications.
journal: International Journal of Innovative Science and Research Technology (IJISRT)

title: Enterovirus RNase L inhibiting RNAs are highly conserved with limited phylogenetic distribution
abstract: RNA molecules form specific 3D structures that facilitate a variety of functions through interactions with other macromolecules. Many RNA viral genomes maintain these structures to interact with and evade host immunity machinery. One such element, the competitive inhibitor RNA (ciRNA), discovered in the protein coding region of the poliovirus serotype 1 (PV1) genome, inhibits a host antiviral protein, ribonuclease L (RNase L). Although some functionally essential structural motifs of the PV1 ciRNA have been studied, the extent of its evolutionary conservation and other structural requirements remained unexplored. Here we combined bioinformatic and biochemical techniques to further define the requirements of a functional ciRNA and assess its phylogenetic distribution. We systematically mutated ciRNA structural features, verifying that ciRNA inhibitory activity requires a conserved loop E motif and a long-range base-pairing interaction, but its peripheral stems are dispensable and in fact a circularly permuted version maintains function. A structure-based homology search identified potential ciRNAs across the Picornaviridae family, but only a subset of those tested were functional—all are in Enterovirus coxsackiepol. When structural features needed for function were transposed from PV1 ciRNA to an RNA unable to inhibit RNase L, the chimeric RNAs did not gain wild-type function, and chemical probing data revealed that these nonfunctional RNAs are unable to form the correct secondary structure. Overall, the dual constraints of encoding a protein and forming a specific functional structure appear to not only limit the sequence diversity, but also the phylogenetic distribution, of ciRNAs.
